period_supported.note: Observed typical days only. Labor Day (2026-09-07) and Columbus Day (2026-10-12) are not in this table.

min_observed_days_reason: The full window has 63 typical weekdays, 14 Saturdays and 13 Sundays. A gate of 10 lets weekend day types be ranked while still asking for most of the weekend days in the window. The Step 7 review list uses 20 for weekday and weekend groups combined. Use the sensitivity table on the ranking screen to see how many routes change when this value moves.

riders_per_service_hour.label: Boardings per scheduled service hour
riders_per_service_hour.meaning: Higher means more boardings for each hour of bus service the schedule plans. Long, slow routes and short, fast routes are not directly alike.

riders_per_trip.label: Boardings per scheduled trip running
riders_per_trip.denominator: sum of trips running in each hour (GTFS). A trip that spans two clock hours counts in both.
riders_per_trip.meaning: Higher means more boardings for each bus on the road. It counts boardings and does not show how full buses are.

share_hours_above_p75.label: Share of hours above the high riders-per-trip line
share_hours_above_p75.numerator: hours where boardings / trips running is above the route's fixed Jan-May 75th percentile
share_hours_above_p75.denominator: hours with at least one scheduled trip
share_hours_above_p75.meaning: Higher means the route more often runs above its own usual level. It compares the route with itself, not with other routes.

mean_daily_boardings.label: Average daily boardings
mean_daily_boardings.meaning: Higher means more people board this route on an average day of this type.
